title_zh: 钟南山：敢医敢言的「国士」
title_en: Famous Chinese People (7/20): Zhong Nanshan, the Doctor Who Dared to Speak
note_en: English uses either "although" or "but," never both, yet Chinese normally pairs them: 虽然他已经年过八旬，但在新冠疫情最严重的时候，他依然每天只睡几个小时 "Although he was over eighty, at the height of the epidemic he still slept only a few hours a night." 虽然 (suīrán) opens the concession and 但 (dàn) or 但是 opens the main clause; using both is standard, not repetition. 依然 "still" often joins in to stress the contrast.
